Name: Starry Blue UI (Content Patcher)
Author: sqbr
Description:
This is compatible with all the translations, as far as I can tell, but let me know if you hit any issues.

It shouldn't interfere with any mods that aren't also modifying the UI. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/67730946]cookietehcat[/url] has created [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21682]Compatibility Patches for Starry Blue UI[/url]﻿ for a few mods that do affect the UI such as GMCM.

[b]Known Bugs:
[/b]There seems to sometimes be an issue with the Trinket slot. [b]
[/b]This mod often causes errors when combined with other mods which affect the cursor. [b]
[/b] Older versions: The EditCursor option is broken, which is why I removed it from later versions. [b]
[/b]
[b]Installation Guide:[/b]
Install SMAPI, Content Patcher, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14525?tab=files]Theme Manager[/url].
Download the file and unzip.
Put it in the Mods folder.

Edit the config.json of Theme Manager to have the line
[code]"StardewTheme": "Sqbr.StarryBlueUI",[/code]
or set the Theme Manager theme to Sqbr.StarryBlueUI with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[b]For Stardew Valley Version 1.5/ Version 1.0 of this mod only:

[/b]

Download Spirit's [url=https://m.blog.naver.com/khs3400/222049471897] [Stardew Valley] Font property mode[/url]  and copy and paste this over the contents of the config file for that mod:

[code]{
  "Debug": false,
  "HideShadow": true,
  "EnableFixSmallFontLineSpace": false,
  "SmallFontLineSpace": 30,
  "EnableFixFontPixelZoom": false,
  "FontPixelZoom": 1.0,
  "EnableFixFontColor": false,
  "FontColor": [],
  "EnableFixImgColor": true,
  "ImgColor": [
{
"Name": "Money",
"Target": [128,0,0,255],
"Change": [24,10,69,255]
}
  ]
}
[/code]
Mods shown in screenshots:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12442]Less Ugly Town Interiors[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10852]Vanilla Tweaks

[/url]Versions:
1.0.2: Added EditCursors
1.0.3: Removed EditCursors code because it started breaking everything for some reason. I am sure it didn't use to!
1.1: Version 1.6 compatibility
1.11: Base Trinket slot colour fixed
1.12: Now uses Theme Manager
1.13: Fixed some minor visual bugs.
